segments.he: וּמוּתָּר בְּבֵיצָה טוֹרְמִיטָא. מַאי בֵּיצָה טוֹרְמִיטָא? אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: עַבְדָּא דְּעָבֵיד לַהּ שָׁוֵי אַלְפָּא דִּינָרֵי, וּמְעַיֵּיל לַהּ אַלְפָּא זִימְנֵי בְּמַיָּא חַמִּימֵי וְאַלְפָּא זִימְנֵי בְּמַיָּא קָרִירֵי עַד דְּמִתְזוּטְרָא כִּי הֵיכִי דְּבָלַע יָתַהּ, וְאִם אִית כֵּיבָא — סָרֵיךְ עֲלַהּ, וְכַד נָפְקָא וְאָתְיָא, יָדַע אָסְיָא מַאי סַמָּא מִתְבְּעֵי לֵיהּ וּבְמַאי מִתַּסִּי.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if one said: Cooked food is konam for me, and for that reason I will not taste it, he is prohibited from tasting a loose cooked food but is permitted to taste a thick one, «and» he is likewise «permitted to» eat «a turemita egg.» The Gemara asks: «What» is a «turemita egg? Shmuel said: A slave who» knows how to «prepare it is worth a thousand dinars. And» this is how one prepares it: «He inserts it into hot water a thousand times and in cold water a thousand times, until it shrinks» enough «so that it can be swallowed» whole. «And if there is a lesion» in one’s intestines, part of the lesion «adheres to» the egg, «and when» the egg «emerges the doctor knows what medicine» the patient «requires and with what» he «can be healed.» It is therefore an important dish for medicinal purposes.

moves.summary: quotes the mishna's permission of the turemita egg to one vowing off cooked food
asks what a turemita egg is
an egg shrunk by a thousand hot and cold dips so it can be swallowed, used diagnostically by doctors

positions.claim: a turemita egg is one alternately dipped a thousand times in hot and cold water until it shrinks to be swallowed whole
